datasets.name: biwi
datasets.source: Biwi Kinect Head Pose Database (G. Fanelli et al., 'Random Forests for Real Time 3D Face Analysis', IJCV 101(3), 2013; ETH Zurich). The original archive https://data.vision.ee.ethz.ch/cvl/gfanelli/kinect_head_pose_db.tgz returns HTTP 403 and the ETHZurich/biwi_kinect_head_pose HF dataset is only a loader script pointing to it (checked 2026-10-08). Obtained from the unofficial HuggingFace mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZihanWang1029/BIWI (BIWI/BK-1.zip = sequences 01-10, BIWI/BK-2.zip = sequences 11-24; sha256 equal to the HF LFS object ids). The mirror's 'mit' tag is the uploader's and is NOT the dataset licence.
datasets.license: NON-COMMERCIAL / RESEARCH-ONLY (flag): 'This database is made available for non-commercial use such as university research and education.' (BIWI readme, as quoted on the ETHZurich/biwi_kinect_head_pose dataset card). Cite Fanelli et al. IJCV 2013.

datasets.name: celeba
datasets.source: CelebA (Liu, Luo, Wang, Tang, 'Deep Learning Face Attributes in the Wild', ICCV 2015; MMLAB, CUHK, http://mmlab.ie.cuhk.edu.hk/projects/CelebA.html). In-the-wild images: the official 14-part archive Img/img_celeba.7z (parts dated 2022-05-31, 734,003,200 B each except the last) obtained via the third-party HF mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/noname110/celeba (revision 438b96fa79375870b726cd408a3da1eda4f074c4; Google-Drive export zips CelebA-20240106T040341Z-0NN.zip, LFS sha256 listed in raw/hf_noname110.sha256; the mirror's 'apache-2.0' tag is not the dataset licence), extracted to img_celeba/ (202,599 JPEG). archives/img_align_celeba.zip -> img_align_celeba/. Anno/ (identity_CelebA.txt = the identity labels the authors release on request, list_landmarks_celeba.txt 5-point landmarks of the labelled face in the in-the-wild images, bbox, attributes), Eval/list_eval_partition.txt, README.txt (official).
datasets.license: NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH ONLY, NO REDISTRIBUTION. Official agreement (project page, checked 2026-10-11): 'The CelebA dataset is available for non-commercial research purposes only.' 'All images of the CelebA dataset are obtained from the Internet which are not property of MMLAB' 'You agree not to reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, trade, resell or exploit for any commercial purposes, any portion of the images and any portion of derived data.' 'You agree not to further copy, publish or distribute any portion of the CelebA dataset. Except, for internal use at a single site within the same organization it is allowed to make copies of the dataset.' 'The face identities are released upon request for research purposes only.' README.txt: 'Their use is RESTRICTED to non-commercial research and educational purposes.' Images are web photos of celebrities (third-party copyright).
